description: Unauthorized S3 Bucket Access via Misconfigured IAM Policies The current implementation uses a common Lambda execution role with broad S3 access permissions. While the buckets block public access, the Lambda functions have read/write access to all objects, potentially allowing access to any user's files if the authentication logic is bypassed. An attacker who compromises the Lambda function or exploits an authentication bypass could access or modify any file in the bucket, regardless of ownership.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
recommendation: Implement S3 bucket path partitioning based on user identities
recommendation: Implement fine-grained IAM permissions using session policies

description: Insecure API Communications Due to Missing TLS The current API Gateway configuration does not specify TLS certificate configuration through ACM, potentially allowing unencrypted communications or weak cipher usage. An attacker performing a man-in-the-middle attack could intercept API communications, potentially exposing sensitive data or file contents during transit.
references: recommendation: Configure ACM certificate for API Gateway

description: Race Conditions in File Operations The system lacks proper concurrency controls for file operations. Multiple simultaneous operations on the same file could lead to race conditions. An attacker could exploit race conditions by initiating multiple concurrent operations on the same file, potentially causing data corruption or unauthorized access to in-transit data.
references: recommendation: Implement optimistic locking using DynamoDB

description: Insufficient Logging and Monitoring While API Gateway has basic logging enabled, S3 bucket access logging is not explicitly configured, making it difficult to track and audit file access patterns. An attacker could perform unauthorized file access or modifications without detection due to insufficient logging and monitoring.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
mitreATT&CK: T1562.008 - Impair Defenses: Disable Cloud Logs
owaspTop10: A09:2021-Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
recommendation: Enable comprehensive S3 access logging
recommendation: Implement enhanced monitoring and alerting

description: Single Region Availability Risk The system is deployed in a single AWS region, making it vulnerable to region-wide outages and potentially violating data residency requirements. A region-wide AWS outage or targeted DDoS attack could make the entire system unavailable.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1499 - Endpoint Denial of Service

description: Extraneous Component Security Risk The redundant File Metadata Manager has unnecessary access to the metadata store, increasing the attack surface without providing additional functionality. An attacker who compromises the File Metadata Manager could access or modify file metadata despite the component being unnecessary for system operation.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1578 - Modify Cloud Compute Infrastructure
recommendation: Remove redundant File Metadata Manager
recommendation: Audit and remove unnecessary IAM permissions
